title: Mark and sweep as a modular synth
label: Modular synth case as the heap: ten faceplates on two rails with an empty bay, nine patch-cable pointers from two roots, black LEDs on the five marked modules, and D, H and I, a cycle no root reaches. Tap to sweep, then cut a cable.
caption: Patch cables are pointers. Marking follows every cable out from the stack and the registers and blacks the LED of each module it reaches, so A, B, C, G and K are live; D, H and I patch only into each other, a cycle no root reaches. Sweeping pulls those three off the rails and leaves empty bays. Cut B→C and C and K go dark, and the next sweep collects them too.
